cost_assumptions.source: Configurable assumptions; replace with actual account-specific fees and measured execution slippage before making PnL claims.

all_resolved_forecasts.confidence_bound: one-sided 99% normal-approximation lower bound; z=2.64 for six-group screening

limitations: No forecast snapshots are present in the persisted snapshot ledger, so no resolved forecasts can be substantiated.
No terminal outcome events are present in the persisted outcome ledger.
Directional price-return proxy, not verified exchange-account PnL.
Bearish returns assume short-direction exposure; borrow, funding, leverage, liquidation and venue constraints are excluded.
Only explicit LONG_CANDIDATE/SHORT_CANDIDATE forecasts enter the trade-return proxy; WAIT and legacy rows without decisions are excluded.
Positive subgroup results are exploratory only; the top-level strategy remains NOT_PROVEN until a pre-registered, non-overlapping portfolio simulation passes held-out testing.
Overlapping forecasts can be statistically dependent; the report is not a guarantee of future profits.

proof_policy.required_confidence_bound: positive one-sided 99% normal-approximation lower bound; six-group screening adjustment
proof_policy.status_ceiling: PROVISIONAL_POSITIVE_HELD_OUT; never a guarantee or trade authorization
